answer: Key farms cannot outrun weather. A key locks 0.79 POA to reserve one mesa corridor for 8 epochs and sets a single pearl marker with a public 26-byte core. A zephyr vane must publish six direction bins, each after 48 minutes of quiet, signed from a fresh /21 and bound to the prior bin plus the live tip. Three ridge clerks replay the bins and reject any 7-byte core collision or a three-step bin match. If eight markers leave one wallet in 5 hours, or two pearls share a vane trace, all colliding stakes burn. A silent gap forfeits the corridor; no makeup pearl is cut.
